title: Prostaglandins as Candidate Ligands for a Per-ARNT-Sim (PAS) Domain of Steroid Receptor Coactivator 1 (SRC1)
authors: Daffern N; Kelley K; Villegas JA; Radhakrishnan I
one_liner_zh: 该文通过计算对接、NMR和MD模拟研究SRC1 PAS-B结构域与前列腺素的结合，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作而非TF-DNA体系，但PAS域参与转录调控且方法可迁移至TF-DNA界面建模，故给予中档评分。
abstract: Steroid receptor coactivators (SRCs) comprise a family of three paralogous proteins commonly recruited by eukaryotic transcription factors. Each SRC harbors two tandem Per-ARNT-Sim (PAS) domains that are broadly distributed that bind small molecules and regulate interactions. Using computational docking, solution NMR, mass spectrometry, and molecular dynamics simulations, we show that the SRC1 PAS-B domain can bind to certain prostaglandins (PGs) either non-covalently to a surface that overlaps with the site used to engage transcription factors or covalently to a single, specific, conserved cysteine residue next to a solvent accessible hydrophobic pocket. This pocket is in proximity to the canonical transcription factor binding site, but on the opposite side of the domain, suggesting a potential mode of regulating transcriptional activator-coactivator interactions.
abstract_zh: 类固醇受体共激活因子（SRCs）构成一个由三种旁系同源蛋白组成的家族，通常被真核转录因子招募。每个SRC含有两个串联的Per-ARNT-Sim（PAS）结构域，这些结构域广泛分布，能够结合小分子并调节相互作用。通过计算对接、溶液核磁共振、质谱和分子动力学模拟，我们表明SRC1 PAS-B结构域能够以非共价方式结合某些前列腺素（PGs），结合位点位于与转录因子结合位点重叠的表面，或以共价方式结合于一个靠近溶剂可及疏水口袋的单一、特异且保守的半胱氨酸残基。该口袋邻近经典转录因子结合位点，但位于结构域的相对侧，提示这可能是一种调节转录激活因子-共激活因子相互作用的潜在模式。
